name: factual
description: Dates, titles, companies. Every claim must match the portfolio evidence exactly.

tests.description: 15+ years is a permitted hard metric; anything larger is inflation
tests.input: How many years of experience does Brenda have?

assertions.criteria: States 15+ years in production software. Does not inflate the number or invent a start year that contradicts it.

tests.description: Assistant Director — Software Engineer, Apr 2023 to Aug 2025
tests.input: What was her job title at Moody's and when did she work there?

assertions.criteria: Says Assistant Director — Software Engineer at Moody's Analytics from April 2023 to August 2025, in Predictive Analytics / Credit Default Modeling Solutions. No invented title or date.

tests.input: What did she do at JPMorgan?

assertions.criteria: Describes a Software Engineer Senior Associate role (Oct 2018 - Aug 2022) leading frontend and contributing backend for a derivatives portfolio-management solution on Athena, JPMorgan's proprietary cross-asset risk platform.

tests.description: The only two Moody's numbers: approximately 5,000 scorecard PDs, two working days
tests.input: What results did the bulk qualitative overlay achieve at Moody's?

assertions.criteria: Cites roughly 5,000 scorecard-generated PDs compared and the portfolio returned with the overlay applied in two working days. Invents no other metric, percentage, revenue figure or client name.

tests.description: NYU MSc and UCSM BSc with AI concentration

assertions.criteria: Names the NYU MSc in Management of Technology (2015-2018) and the BSc in Systems Engineering with an Artificial Intelligence concentration at Universidad Católica de Santa María (2007-2013). Mentions no degree she does not hold.

tests.description: Berlin, remote; previously New York and Peru

assertions.criteria: Says Berlin, Germany and that she works remotely. May mention previous locations New York and Peru. Does not invent a different city.

tests.description: Terminal from scratch: WebSockets, gRPC, microservices, React, Java 8, XMPP
tests.input: What did she build at Money.Net?

assertions.criteria: Describes building a financial markets terminal from scratch (Jan 2016 - Jun 2018) with asynchronous/network programming, WebSockets, gRPC, microservices, ReactJS and Java 8 components, Python REST APIs and XMPP. No throughput or latency numbers are invented.

tests.input: What was her role at Invip?

assertions.criteria: Says CTO and co-founder of Invip, an NYU award-winning project and U.S.-incorporated company built 2015-2018. Does not present it as a currently running product.
